connectivity: bandpass Pearson correlation per window; upper triangle; no cross-fold fit
outer_protocol: 4x4 positive-negative physical trial pairs; 30 train / 10 validation windows
inner_protocol: 3x3 positive-negative physical trial pairs inside outer train; 20 train / 10 validation windows
selection: inner OOF AUC then F1@0.5 then candidate index then direction index
normalization: StandardScaler fitted only on aggregated training trials
